gaps.valueSet: Rule 5 paired acute and convalescent varicella IgG evidence
gaps.reason: the source marks four-fold-rise logic not operational and the IgG-ratio test value set not implemented with no LOINC codes; SEM_V1 cannot pair serial specimens, enforce the 10-to-180-day interval, or compare antibody titers, so the wholly inoperable rule is omitted

the source marks both contact-with-a-case and outbreak-risk-group criteria not implemented; SEM_V1 has no epidemiologic contact or outbreak-membership evidence, so the wholly inoperable rash-plus-epidemiology rule is omitted rather than allowing rash alone to report
the source's inoperable four-fold-rise and IgG-ratio alternatives are omitted from VAR-R8; the implemented culture, nucleic-acid, antigen, and IgM alternatives remain
the pack implements the source default of age younger than 50 years; SEM_V1 rule packs do not carry a jurisdiction-authored override for this threshold
the source identifies death-certificate varicella evidence, but SEM_V1 has no death-certificate evidence
